purpose: Compare evidence retrieval plus a general answer prompt against the current fine classification gates. The simplified approach has not been validated.

comparison.baseline: v9 clean C1 #2640 and C2 #2641; refresh the online export before implementation and record any new baseline runs separately
comparison.candidate: Full raw dialogue and full concept graph reach the answer model; Jev supplies retrieval candidates rather than question-type gates
comparison.caution: End-to-end histories can diverge because first-turn answers differ. Do not claim a single-field causal effect from these runs.

retrievalProposal.pathCandidates: all 39 existing business measurement paths with readable product and domain labels
retrievalProposal.mappingQueryInput: only the candidate-path subgraph; never pass the full concept graph into the existing mapping binding selector
